comment: Sensor registry configuration of the stock OnePlus firmware, copied
byte for byte from the vendor and odm partitions. The ADSP sensor
image reads these through hexagonrpcd; `install` is relative to the
hexagonrpcd root. They are ROM data common to every unit of the model,
not per-unit calibration: the per-unit registry is imported at install
extraction: fsck.erofs --extract of each partition image, no mount; see packaging/firmware-manifest.json for the same OTA
distribution: Original vendor files redistributed unmodified, on the same basis as packaging/firmware/
